title: NOOR-GHATEH: A BENCHMARK DATASET FOR EVALUATING ARABIC WORD SEGMENTATION TOOLS IN HADITH DOMAIN
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark dataset for Arabic word segmentation specifically in the 'Hadith Domain'. The dataset is collected from the book 'Shariat al-Islam', which contains chapters on Islamic jurisprudence and is described as a 'historical text in the field of hadith'. Hadith and Islamic jurisprudence are central to the Islamic faith, directly linking the paper's subject matter to religion/faith.
